ns2:course.label: Power System Dyn & Stability
ns2:course.description: Detailed modeling of the synchronous machine and its controls, such as excitation system and turbine-governor dynamics; time-scales and reduced order models; non-linear and linear multi-machine models; stability analysis using energy functions; power system stabilizers. Same as CSE 544. Prerequisite: ECE 476. Recommended: concurrent registration in ECE 515.
